title: [DEV] "PH" gets added in Treatments history when manual bolus (not delivered by pump)
symptom: When performing a manual bolus with 'do not bolus, record only' or via the AAPSClient Calculator, 'PH' gets added to the treatment history in addition to 'NS'.
cause: The issue is that the original fix did not include a check for a temporaryId when pumpId is null, causing 'PH' to be added.
fix: The fix was applied in commits 275e52a546791ff044121bce6984a778b724a2c6 and ccabee0399d33427ffa8837e53d6756d569e99b5, which likely add a check to exclude entries with temporaryId and null pumpId.
